cue.purpose: Speaker cues and column heads, uppercase mono.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Progress bars, dialogs rising, disclosure chevrons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that does the job on a screen: Generate, Change voice, Transcribe, Save.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid #f2c200; background: #ffd83d; color: #1b1d22; font: 580 14.5px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f2c200; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2c200; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dark Button
components.description: Main secondary action in a toolbar (Export, Send to Studio).
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid #191c22; background: #191c22; color: #ebe9e4; font: 580 14.5px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-dark:hover { background: #2c313b; } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2c200; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid #c9cbd3; background: #fff; color: #1b1d22; font: 580 14.5px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #f5f5f7; border-color: #5f6470; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2c200; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid #c9cbd3; background: #fff; color: #1b1d22; font: 14.5px system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; width: 240px; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #4a4e58; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,216,61,.45); }

components.name: Speaker Cue
components.description: Signature: a highlighter swipe in the character's cast colour naming who speaks a line.
components.css: .ds-cue { display: inline-flex; font: 600 11.5px/1 ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1b1d22; padding: 5px 8px 4px; border-radius: 3px 6px 4px 7px; background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 0 2px, var(--cue, #ff9cc2) 2px calc(100% - 3px), transparent calc(100% - 3px)); transform: rotate(-.6deg); } .ds-cue-green { --cue: #7fe0a6; }

components.name: Line State
components.description: Render state of a Studio line.
components.css: .ds-state { font: 600 10.5px ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 5px; background: #f5f5f7; color: #5f6470; } .ds-ready { color: #1d7f55; background: #e2f4ea; } .ds-stale { color: #9a6400; background: #fff1d6; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: Booth rail; the active tool gets a lighter booth fill and a yellow icon.
components.html: Text to SpeechStudio
components.css: .ds-rail { background: #191c22; padding: 12px; width: 220px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 9px; color: #a4a9b4; text-decoration: none; font: 540 14.5px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav:hover { background: #22262e; color: #ebe9e4; } .ds-on { background: #2c313b; color: #fff; } .ds-on svg { color: #ffd83d; }

narrative.overview: A dark booth frames white script pages on a cool grey desk. Every line visibly belongs to a speaker through a highlighter-coloured cue, with timecodes in the margin. Yellow is the action; cast colours are identity; state colours are small labels.
keyCharacteristics: System sans + mono for cues and times

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Yellow means do this or this is yours; never a large background.

rules.name: Cast colour is identity
rules.body: A character keeps one colour everywhere in a project.

rules.name: Mono is measurement
rules.body: Mono only for cues, timecodes, durations and counts.

dos: Show who speaks every line and whether it is rendered.
Offer upload and record side by side wherever audio comes in.
donts: Don't add coloured side stripes to rows.
Don't fake materials (vinyl grooves, paper texture, embossing).
Don't load web fonts or CDN assets.
